tool: 本机 Codex CLI 的内置 image_generation（OpenAI ImageGen），用 codex exec 逐幅调用
说明: 六个地域各一条长卷，每条四幅，按地点表 scripts/rules/places.gd 的十层顺序从左到右排。第 2~4 幅以前一幅为参考图续画；拼接时在两侧留白处交叉淡化。每幅的完整 prompt = 画风 + 地域.调 + 地域.幅[i] + 几何（第 2~4 幅再加 续画）。
画风: Use case: stylized-concept. NEW ORIGINAL ultrawide landscape background panel for a 2D side-view action RPG, as wide as the image tool allows. Polished hand-painted 2D game environment in the craft of a premium Chinese dark-folklore side-scroller: deliberately shaped big masses, readable silhouettes in staggered depth planes, painterly but not photographic and not chibi, restrained palette with a few cinnabar accents. No people, no characters, no monsters, no animals, no lettering, no UI, no frame, no watermark.
几何: Scene geometry: authentic orthographic side view. A broad horizontal walkable ground band runs from y=53% down through the BOTTOM edge; the feet of overlaid game sprites will stand at y=79%. The whole lower half must be a nearly flat, continuous, medium-light ground band so dark sprites read on it: no dropoff, no platform cutaway, no water in the band, no black lower bar, no line dividing the floor. Keep the lower center open for a hero and enemies. Keep the LEFT 18% and RIGHT 18% of the frame quiet: only sky, distant hills and plain ground there, no landmark cut by the image edge, so neighbouring panels can be blended. Put this panel's landmarks in the middle, set back above the walking line. Vary silhouette spacing so a camera can pan horizontally.
续画: Continue the attached reference panorama to the RIGHT as the next panel of the same long scroll: same horizon height, same ground band height and texture, same light direction, same palette and brushwork. The new panel's left edge must read as a direct continuation of the reference's right edge. Do not draw a second sun, moon or other single sky landmark from the reference: the sky simply continues, so the long scroll never shows two suns.

drought.调: Ancient China, a killing drought on the loess plateau: bleached pale sky with a dull white sun, heat shimmer, ochre and dust-umber earth, bone-white highlights, cracked dry soil as the walking band.
幅: Village edge of Dead Willow village: a dead willow burned down to a black stump, collapsed rammed-earth walls, an empty stone well with a broken windlass; further on a roadside post station with a weathered stone ram statue and a dry horse trough.
A broken stone bridge still standing over a completely dry riverbed, stranded boat hulls in the cracked mud; beyond it a rammed-earth fort half buried in drifting yellow sand up to its window sills.

A ridge with a crude rain-praying altar of stacked stones, burnt-out incense and faded paper charms; an abandoned government granary with its doors hanging open, empty inside; three dry gullies cutting the plain.

A bitter spring under a cliff beside a ruined hamlet; a flat scattered with bleached ox bones; then a vast scorched plain burned white under a dark brooding sky where thunder rolls but no rain falls, the place of the wood tribulation.

plague.调: Ancient China, a plague and fire stricken river-east town: soot-grey and sickly yellow-green haze, mugwort smoke, black timber, lime-white walls stained with ash, ember-orange accents, packed earth street as the walking band.
幅: A narrow alley of a plague town with mugwort smoke, every other door nailed shut with crossed planks; lime kilns beyond with thick white smoke rising.
A ward of sealed houses with boarded doors and blank white notices pasted on them; a river ferry landing where grain sacks were burned to black heaps.
A coal-smoke city wall with every window shuttered; a lane of shut doors; a sick village with an empty apothecary and bare herb drying racks.
A charnel hill with pyres still smouldering; a market square under a rumbling dry sky; then a mountain whose summit is on fire, glowing white-hot, the place of the fire tribulation.

mine.调: Ancient China, the Taihang mountains during mine disasters: dark slate and cold grey rock, rust and lantern-amber accents, timber props, coal dust in the air, a packed grey gravel road as the walking band.
幅: An open-pit iron mine with half of its rim collapsed, timber scaffolds and an ore cart on wooden rails; a kiln yard whose roof has caved in.
Deep shaft headframes with rope windlasses; a ravine where loose rock keeps falling; a slope where the ground has sunk and swallowed a pack train's cargo.
A sealed mine mouth with burned joss paper offerings; a seep of black water from a cave mouth; a hamlet whose roof beams are all propped and sagging.
A town split in two by a deep crack in the earth; then a whole mountain sinking into the ground with only a temple roof ridge left above the rubble, the place of the earth tribulation.

war.调: Ancient China, the northern frontier after war: cold steel-blue dusk, dry steppe grass, distant smoke columns, torn red banners as the only strong colour, a trampled frontier road as the walking band.
幅: A plain bristling with broken halberds stuck in the ground like a crop of iron; an iron-gated frontier pass with its gate shut and scorched.
A town of empty hitching posts with saddles hung on them; a burned fortress with banners still smouldering; a ruined rampart where survivors once hid.
A slope with a defeated army's collapsed tents; a river crossing choked with broken carts; a gravel pass stained dark.
A lone besieged fortress town on a ridge; then a range of knife-edged rock blades singing in the wind under a metallic sky, the place of the metal tribulation.

flood.调: Ancient China, the Jianghuai lowlands in a great flood: low grey rain sky, brown floodwater stretching across the middle distance, drowned rice paddies; a raised muddy earthen levee road forms the walking band in the foreground, with no water on it.
幅: A breached levee with a torn gap pouring water into the fields; a marsh with floating debris and capsized boats.
A ferry landing with overturned ferries; a polder village drowned up to its roof tiles; loose roof tiles drifting past.
Rotting rice seedlings in standing water; a deliberately breached dike beside a village on stilts; a flooded walled city whose market stands waist-deep in water.
A silted river mouth of sucking mud; then a vast still mirror-calm water surface hiding a drowned county town whose pagoda tip barely shows, the place of the water tribulation.

court.调: The celestial bureaucracy above the clouds: cold white jade, pale gold and ink-blue shadows, an endless sea of clouds below, beautiful and eerily lifeless; a white jade terrace paving forms the walking band.
幅: A celestial pavilion of records: endless ledger shelves and scroll racks under jade eaves, the cloud sea beyond.
A hall of archives with towering cases of fate ledgers; a pivot gate where a prisoner road begins, with iron cangue racks.
A judgement terrace with an empty raised seat; a cloud-gate platform opening onto a road of clouds that descends toward the mortal world.
An altar where calamities are assigned by quota, a hatch in the clouds through which plague is released downward; then the Hall of Investiture with a waiting jade tablet on a high dais.
